locked.summon: The gold won't take. Something in the stone is waiting for someone else, or for later.
locked.altar: The altar is cold under your hand. It isn't time.
locked.compass: The needle spins and spins. Whatever it points at doesn't want to be found. Not yet.
locked.scroll: The scroll's ink won't stay still long enough to read. It isn't for you. Not yet.
locked.azazel: Something tried to come through, and couldn't. Not yet. He isn't ready for you, and you aren't ready for him.

scroll_good: The ink crawls away from your fingers. The Chariot doesn't write to people like you.
work: The cult's work. It's in your hands now, and it doesn't wash off.
conversion: Its eyes go gold, and it doesn't know your name any more. Somebody will notice.
totem: The totem cracks. The blow that should have killed you goes somewhere else.
